title: The Addams Family: Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt - Icebox
description:
A super cool gothic song that could fit haunted houses or castles very well. It is also known as Granny's Crystal Ball from the name of the other level it accompanies.

For the little story I found a vgmusic midi of this song lying in an old midi folder I last visited in 2013. Seems like 2013 me used to love this song a lot, so I just ported it.
